segments.contextAfter: Discussion

This value describes the minimum thickness in the primary axis of a split view—width if the split view’s [`isVertical`](nssplitview/isvertical.md) value is [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), height if it’s [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false).
